name: TAC (DOCEtaxel / DOXOrubicin / Cyclophosphamide)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The three-drug taxane/anthracycline/alkylator TAC cytotoxic backbone is not biomarker-restricted; it is an option across HR-positive/HER2-negative and HR-negative/HER2-negative (TNBC) early breast cancer (studied in node-positive disease, BCIRG 001). ER, PR, and HER2 are tested to guide added endocrine therapy (HR-positive) and HER2-directed therapy (HER2-positive), not to select the TAC backbone. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens (BINV-M 2 and 3 of 10; Other Recommended).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC), and triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC))

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling; give before docetaxel. Confirm exact schedule against institutional order set.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: anthracycline plus cyclophosphamide plus taxane; select antiemetic prophylaxis per the NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). The exact per-regimen tier is designated in the NCCN Antiemesis guideline / order template (not established in the provided sources).

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: REQUIRED. All cycles are given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n; TAC carries high febrile-neutropenia risk.
Antiemetics: prophylaxis per NCCN emetic-risk framework (Appendix D). Specific tier per NCCN Antiemesis order template.
monitoring: LVEF at baseline and cardiac monitoring during anthracycline therapy (BINV-M 1 of 10)
CBC before each cycle (high febrile-neutropenia risk)
liver and renal function before each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: cumulative DOXOrubicin approaching 450 mg/m2 (warn) or 550 mg/m2 (hard cap)
doseModificationRules.text: Track cumulative lifetime anthracycline exposure; 450 mg/m2 warrants review, 550 mg/m2 is the conventional hard cap due to cumulative cardiotoxicity (DeVita 12th ed. lines 19908 to 19919). Physician decides.
Review required. TAC is high febrile-neutropenia risk; growth-factor support is integral. Physician decides.

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 6 of 10. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 6 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n). ISMP tall-man.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 6 of 10. DOXOrubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 6 cycles. ISMP tall-man. Anthracycline cumulative lifetime cardiotoxicity cap applied (warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2); DeVita 12th ed. lines 19908 to 19919.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 6 of 10. Cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 6 cycles, with myeloid growth factor support (footnote n).
